title: Hallucinated Tool Output x Monitor Trust: Compounding Fabrication and Oversight

original_idea.body: In a mock-tool agent allow the model to faithfully report or fabricate tool outputs, give the monitor self-reported vs ground-truth traces, and measure the detection-rate gap.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Trace fabrication poisoning the monitor's evidence base is a structural audit-trail risk.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Mock-tool agent, self-reported vs ground-truth trace, measure gap; accessible, no training.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused detection-rate-gap measurement; mock-tool harness is one dependency.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Cheap mock-tool harness, public models, lab-independent.

novelty.reasoning: Trace faithfulness discussed; fabricated-trace-vs-monitor measurement may be open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Trace faithfulness discussed; the fabrication-blinding measurement may be open.
